name: Gerald
source:
A merchant in practice but a thief at heart, Gerald has come to the Kortian Empire in search of a better life. A life far away from the troubles of the western world, but despite this, strife always finds its way into this young man's life.

[From the [url=https://www.dulcetgames.com/kortia]official website[/url]]
